subject.title: fix: drain inbound debounce buffer and followup queues before SIGUSR1 reload

question: Should restart-drain bypass capability be allowed in the public plugin SDK, or must it stay core-internal for this PR?
rationale: The PR currently exposes enqueueInternal on a published ChannelRunQueue surface, and accepting that would intentionally let plugin code bypass the gateway-draining rejection boundary.

options.title: Keep Bypass Internal
options.body: Require the PR to remove public SDK bypass surfaces and route trusted restart-drain work through core-owned private helpers or registry handles.

options.title: Approve Public SDK Bypass
options.body: Accept the new public plugin API only with explicit docs, contract tests, and security/compatibility rationale for third-party plugins.

options.title: Pause For Persistence Path
options.body: Defer this transient drain branch if maintainers prefer the broader persistent followup queue approach to own the restart-loss class.

recommendation.title: Keep Bypass Internal
recommendation.body: Require the PR to remove public SDK bypass surfaces and route trusted restart-drain work through core-owned private helpers or registry handles.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent blame and commits show the strongest current ownership across the SDK, followup queue, command queue, and gateway restart surfaces.
